import os,re,json,itertools as it, math
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
Aoff=((0,1),(1,0),(1,1),(1,2)); Boff=((0,0),(0,1),(0,2),(1,1))
from collections import Counter
# Gather ALL anchor->marker correspondences with minimal-distance assignment (bijection per demo). Then analyze (ar,ac)->(or,oc).
occ_mark=[]
for n in [1,2,3,4]:
    inp=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; out=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cs=comps(inp); marks=[(i,j,v) for i,row in enumerate(out) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v]
    # greedy: each occurrence picks nearest marker; check no conflicts
    used=set(); occs=[]
    for ar,ac,typ in sorted([((r0,c0),'A' if off==Aoff else 'B') for (r0,c0),off in cs]):
        cands=[m for m in marks if m[2]==(3 if typ=='A' else 1)]
        best=min(cands,key=lambda m:(abs(ar-m[0])+abs(ac-m[1]), abs(ar*H-out_m[0])) for out_m in [])
        occs.append(((ar,ac,typ),best)); used.add(best[0])
    occ_mark.append(occs)
# Print
for n,om in enumerate(occ_mark):
    print('demo',n+1)
    for oc,(mr,mc,mv) in om:
        print(f'   {oc}->{(mr,mc)}')

import collections
# Compute folded (torus) cover multiplicities per demo; see which cells have how many V/U covers, and relate to out
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
sh_u=((0,0),(0,1),(0,2),(1,1)); sh_v=((0,1),(1,0),(1,1),(1,2))
for n in [3,4,7]:
    inp=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; out=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    S=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for c in comps(inp):
        rs=[r for r,_ in c]; cc=[x for _,x in c]
        r0,c0=min(rs),min(cc)
        S[tuple(sorted((r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in c))].append((r0,c0))
    SV, SU = S.get(sh_v), S.get(sh_u)
    print('demo',n,'out:',[(i,j,out[i][j]) for i in range(3) for j in range(6) if out[i][j]])
    for name,pts,base,val in [('V',SV,0,3),('U',SU,3,1)]:
        cnt=collections.Counter((p[0]%3,p[1]%6) for p in pts)
        print(f'  {name} anchor-counts:',dict(cnt))

steps.input:
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
sh_u=((0,0),(0,1),(0,2),(1,1)); sh_v=((0,1),(1,0),(1,1),(1,2))
for n in range(1,8):
    inp=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; out=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0]); marks=[(i,j,out[i][j]) for i in range(3) for j in range(6) if out[i][j]]
    S=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for c in comps(inp):
        rs=[r for r,_ in c]; cc=[x for _,x in c]
        r0,c0=min(rs),min(cc)
        S[tuple(sorted((r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in c))].append((r0,c0))
    SU=sorted(S.get(sh_u,[])); SV=sorted(S.get(sh_v,[]))
    print(f'--- demo{n} marks:',marks,'U anchors cols',sorted({p[1] for p in SU}),'V anchors cols',sorted({p[1] for p in SV}))

            marks[rr][oc]=3 if name=='V' else 1
    return marks
